page_title: AI That Asks Before It Assumes

sources.entry: Logicballs - An AI-powered writing tool to create any type of content and supercharge your productivity.

summary.name: LogicBalls
summary.one_liner: LogicBalls is an AI writing and tools platform that says it checks with the user before generating output, aiming to reduce fabricated content.
use_cases: writing any type of content with AI
getting AI output with fewer fabricated sources
accessing many AI tools from one subscription
comparing outputs across several AI models
drafting content for students and researchers
summary.what_it_does: The page describes LogicBalls as an AI tool that asks clarifying questions before answering or generating content, positioned as a way to ground outputs in the user's intent. It advertises access to a directory of 5,000+ AI tools and a chat assistant. Plans offer a monthly word allowance (10K on Free, 150K on Pro, 500K on Premium, unlimited on Elite) and access to varying numbers of AI models (3 free, 10 Pro, 15 Premium, 31 Elite). The page also claims 15M+ clarified AI generations and 200K+ users, though these are unverified marketing figures. Specific model names and how the verification step works are not described.
notable: Asks clarifying questions before generating output to reduce fabricated content
Access to 5,000+ AI tools in one subscription
Tiered access to 3 to 31 AI models depending on plan
Listed in eudk/awesome-ai-tools under AI-related tools
caveats: Paid tiers unlock more words, models and features; Pro is $5/month ($59.99/year), Premium $8.25/month ($99/year), Elite $11.67/month ($139.99/year)
Verification claims and user/usage numbers are marketing statements, not independently confirmed
Page does not explain how the verification process works or which AI models are used
